description: This is a shell script designed to handle telemetry data upload to a server, performing tasks such as reading configuration files, managing connection types (direct or Codebig proxy), handling retries and resend queues, and uploading telemetry JSON data with appropriate security contexts.

methods.name: getTelemetryEndpoint
methods.description: Determines the telemetry upload URL by querying device info and RFC configurations.

methods.name: pidCleanup
methods.description: Removes the PID file indicating whether an upload process is active.

methods.name: IsCodebigBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the Codebig proxy is temporarily blocked due to previous failures.

methods.name: get_Codebigconfig
methods.description: Fetches configuration settings related to Codebig, including enabling proxy and connection preferences.

methods.name: useDirectRequest
methods.description: Performs telemetry data upload directly via HTTPS, handling response codes and retries.

methods.name: useCodebigRequest
methods.description: Performs telemetry data upload via the Codebig proxy, with retries and fallback handling.
